# hiok_iot_device (Resource)

A device identity in an IoT hub, with the connection string it authenticates by.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (String)
- `hub_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `connection_string` (String, Sensitive) Carries the device's shared access key.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String)
